response.overview: Reflections is a visualisation and sonification of being elsewhere, the meditative state that occurs when lost in the beauty of natural patterns, audiovisual regularities and irregularities. What begins as appreciation of wild, uncurated aesthetics quickly leads inward, exploring memories conjured by shapes and symmetries. Sound, with its ambiguous nature defined only by the context of the world around it, is especially powerful at unearthing buried mental treasure, and leading meandering thoughts through streams of consciousness.
response.title: Reflections
